subject: Synergetic Systems — ISV connector technical validation & reference plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@synergetic.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@synergetic.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Synergetic + Redwood partner validation

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the quick intro during the partner summit. As discussed, Synergetic Systems is building a connector that integrates our enterprise search + knowledge graph with runtime LLM embeddings and retrieval. We want to validate a reference integration so we can list a certified connector in your partner catalog.

Primary asks:
- A checklist of Redwood-specific integration requirements (auth, routing, caching expectations)
- A partner test plan for end-to-end validation (latency targets, throughput, failure/fallback scenarios)
- Reference deployment notes (hosted vs. private considerations)

Attached is our current connector spec and a sample set of test cases (synergetic-connector-specs.pdf, synergetic-test-cases.xlsx). Can we schedule a short technical kick-off this week? Prefer Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Samir
Director, Integrations
Synergetic Systems
+1 415-555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@synergetic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Synergetic + Redwood partner validation

Samir — appreciate the spec and the context.

High-level plan from our side:
1) Kickoff + scoping call (45m) — align on success criteria (latency SLOs, supported model variants, data handling)
2) Reference runbook — we’ll produce a partner-facing runbook that lists auth flows (API keys / mTLS options), recommended batching and KV cache settings, and a compatibility matrix for model sizes/quantizations.
3) Test harness — Redwood will run an integration harness (synthetic traffic + recorded traces) against your connector; we’ll validate:
   - 99th percentile gen latency under target QPS
   - Correctness of embeddings and retrieval roundtrip
   - Fallback behaviour to smaller model variant on quota exhaustion
4) Certification checklist & publishable asset — once tests pass we publish a short reference architecture and a badge for the partner catalog.

Quick notes for the runbook we’ll draft (we’ll attach initial version to the thread):
- Auth: support API key + optional mTLS for Private customers
- Routing: recommend tag-based routing for production (model_variant=faster/accurate)
- Caching: prefix caching for retrievals (TTL recommendations) and KV cache sizing guidance by token distribution
- Observability: include token-level cost tags and traces so we can surface per-route latency in Console

Proposed kickoff times: Tue 2026-05-05 14:00 PT or Wed 2026-05-06 15:00 PT. Which works for you?

I’ve attached an initial draft of our reference runbook (redwood-reference-runbook.md) and will stub a Jira (RED-3456) for tracking.

— Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@synergetic.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Synergetic + Redwood partner validation

Looping in product partnerships notes — quick reminders from the GTM side so the runbook aligns with what we need to publish:
- Please capture a short partner-friendly architecture diagram and a one-paragraph value proposition blurb we can use in the catalog.
- Certification criteria must include: supported deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private), evidence of SOC2-aligned data handling, and a basic performance matrix (qps/latency at target payload).
- We typically require an executive signoff on the final badge asset; I’ll own that once technical signoff is complete.

Also: include a short compatibility note about older embeddings formats (v1/v2) — some customers still use the v1 schema and we want to confirm backwards compatibility or clearly list unsupported versions.

Marissa
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@synergetic.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@synergetic.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — Synergetic + Redwood partner validation

Thanks — Tue doesn’t work for our engineering lead, Wed 15:00 PT is fine. We’ll be ready with a short deck describing the connector mapping and a sample dataset for the harness. Attached the latest connector spec with a small correction on auth flow.

Next steps:
- Wed 2026-05-06 15:00 PT — technical kickoff (Aditya, Jonas, Samir, Priya)
- Post-kickoff: Redwood to run the harness and share results in RED-3456, expected turnaround 7 business days for the initial validation run.

Samir
